notes: I opened the STAT article and ran two searches. I did not reach EDGAR, so I did not read the Regeneron 10-K or 10-Qs, the Truveta newsroom or Illumina's strategic-investment note. No source named the sequencer used for the Truveta exomes, a per-sample cost or a ramp schedule. STAT is partly paywalled and gave no platform or price. Search snippets say the Regeneron Genetics Center (RGC) held nearly 3M exomes at the Jan 2025 launch. The target is 10M volunteers' exomes over about 5 years. Regeneron put in $119.5M and Illumina put in $20M. The only platform data point is an older GEN article that says RGC moved from HiSeq 2500 to four NovaSeq 6000s. I have not opened it, so its date is unknown. Rough sizing: 10M exomes at about 8-11 Gb each is about 80-110 Pb. Over 5 years that is about 16-22 Pb a year, or roughly 2-3% of the ~800M Gb a year HT base cited in the known list. That volume would partly be RGC's existing run-rate, so the increment is small. It does not argue against 1C. Because it is Regeneron-funded and consumables are bought by RGC, the Illumina equity stake can't be shown to work as a discount. The platform is unconfirmed, so there is no 2B evidence of Ultima.
how_to_mine: Use EDGAR full-text search on 'Truveta' and 'Regeneron Genetics Center' in the Regeneron FY25 10-K and the Q1/Q2'26 10-Qs (CIK 872589). Read the equity-investment and collaboration notes for the Truveta commitment and any exome count. Open Regeneron's Jan 13, 2025 press release and truveta.com/blog/news/truveta-genome-project for the exome count and sequencer. Search RGC job postings and GEN or Fierce interviews with Aris Baras for 'NovaSeq X'. Check Illumina's 10-K or 10-Q for the Truveta stake in the strategic-investments note.
new_candidates: Regeneron 10-K/10-Q Truveta commitment tranches and exome counts (EDGAR full-text search)
RGC job postings or lab pages naming NovaSeq X or Ultima
Illumina 10-Q strategic-investments note on the Truveta stake
